title: 四十七號掛在我手裡
subject: a cloakroom girl at a Shanghai-style hotel ballroom keeps hanging the same man's coat on hook number 47, because he keeps losing his ticket on purpose to stay and chat
caption: 1930s Shanghai shidaiqu big-band dance-hall song, bright swinging 4/4 foxtrot feel with a hotel-ballroom cloakroom setting. a brass-and-reed dance band with muted trumpet and alto sax trading phrases, a clarinet curling around the vocal, a piano playing stride-style chords, a brushed snare with walking upright bass, a short vibraphone figure in the intro. warm mono-style vintage studio sound with a little tape-style softness and crisp horns, no modern low end. female lead in the nasal bright 1930s nightclub-singer style, light swinging phrasing, clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 132 BPM, F major. flirtatious, swinging, wry mood. No rap, no autotune, no synth, no electronic drums, no electric guitar, no modern trap hi-hats.
lyrics:
[Intro - saxes and muted trumpet over the rhythm section]

[Verse 1]
飯店大廳 舞廳的門口
我管衣帽間 管一百個鉤
他每個禮拜 穿同一件大衣
票根一丟 又說找不到

[Pre-Chorus]
小姐 我的票呢
我說 先生 你剛放進口袋

[Chorus]
四十七號 掛在我手裡
你的大衣 比你還安靜
你丟了票根 又丟了藉口
我給你一張新的 今晚

[Verse 2]
舞曲響起來 他不進去跳
倚著櫃檯 數我的鈕釦
我說 先生 舞廳在那邊
他說 我的舞伴 在這邊

[Chorus]
四十七號 掛在我手裡
你的大衣 比你還安靜
你丟了票根 又丟了藉口
我給你一張新的 這次

[Bridge - clarinet and piano alone]
一百個鉤 九十九個空
今晚的樂隊 最後一首

[Chorus]
四十七號 掛在我手裡
你的大衣 比你還安靜
下班以後 一起走出去
我自己拿票 換你的手

[Outro - full band, big finish]
先生 你的票 請收好
